title: The *Forced* Hand
dek: Google withheld Search to force AI on schools. Anthropic opens a roadshow on $895B in compute bets. Who holds leverage; who absorbs the cost.

stories.headline: Schools that reject AI lose Search. Google walked it back. The underlying terms are still Google's.
